evidence.claim: Flagged transaction 3478561 is $74.96 online purchase on new device SM-G935F with mismatched emails.
Device is marked New for this account.
Card history shows 40 transactions, all in_person except the flagged online transaction, indicating stark anomaly.
Card C13487-K1 shares two device profiles with connected cards C09933-K2 and C07987-K2 belonging to different customers.
Three similar prior cases (CC-3350, CC-2243, CC-0890) with identical pattern and exposure were confirmed fraud.
New device signal combined with card-not-present is stronger than plain CNP but not absolute proof without customer verification.

case.summary: Transaction 3478561 is an anomalous online purchase on a new mobile device from a card that otherwise only transacts in-person. The device profile is shared across multiple customers' cards (C09933-K2, C07987-K2), confirming the analyst trigger. Similar closed cases resulted in confirmed fraud. Fraud probability estimated at 0.75 based on coordinated device sharing and historical precedents.
